title: Adobe Experience Manager AI – AEM Accessibility Accelerator
description: Enhance digital accessibility with Adobe Experience Manager AI using Ampera’s AEM Accessibility Accelerator. Automate compliance and improve UX today.
body:
# Ampera AEM Accessibility Accelerator

### A comprehensive accessibility solution designed specifically for Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).

The AEM Accessibility Accelerator is a purpose-built AEM plugin that helps organizations embed accessibility into their everyday content and development workflows. It enables teams to identify, understand, and remediate accessibility issues directly within AEM, supporting both real-time authoring validation and in-depth accessibility audits across pages and content paths. Built with AXE Core and custom rule engine developed for scanning capabilities. By combining visual insights, detailed reporting, and AI-assisted remediation guidance, the accelerator helps teams deliver accessible digital experiences with confidence.

## Core Capabilities

### Author Mode Accessibility Tool

Designed for use directly within AEM Author Mode, this tool enables content authors to identify accessibility issues while creating and editing pages—before they reach production.

What it offers:

On-demand scanning of the current author page

Visual highlighting of issues directly on the page

Component-level mapping, clearly identifying the AEM components associated with each issue

Clear issue descriptions with relevant WCAG references

AI-powered fix suggestions to guide remediation

Ability to export accessibility reports for review and tracking

### Developer & Path-Based Accessibility Scanner

Built for developers, QA teams, and accessibility specialists, this tool supports detailed analysis across individual pages or entire content structures.

What it offers:

Scan a single page or multiple AEM content paths

Efficient multi page path scanning for large sites

Detailed page-level accessibility reports

Consolidated summaries showing overall issues across scanned paths

Severity classification with WCAG mapping. AI-assisted remediation guidance to accelerate fixes

Export options for both page-specific and overall reports

### Accessibility Standards Coverage

The accelerator evaluates content against globally recognized accessibility standards, including:

WCAG 2.x

Level A, Level AA, Level AAA

ACT rules

WAI-ARIA specifications

Industry accessibility best practices

European and US Accessibility Compliance Standards

AI-Assisted Remediation

Both the Author and Developer tools include AI-driven remediation guidance, helping teams:

Understand the root cause of each issue

Receive context-aware fix suggestions

Reduce reliance on manual interpretation of guidelines

Improve consistency and efficiency in accessibility fixes

Installation & Integration

Installed easily via the AEM Package Manager

Minimal configuration required

Seamlessly integrates into existing AEM authoring and development workflows

Can be used alongside other accessibility tools as part of a broader strategy

Reporting & Insights

Structured issue summaries

Component-to-issue traceability

Severity levels and WCAG references

Exportable reports for:

Author-level page scans

Developer page reports

Consolidated multi-page and path-based scans

#### Who It’s For

- 1. Content AuthorsValidate and improve accessibility during authoring
- 2. DevelopersIdentify and fix component and ARIA-related issues
- 3. QA & Accessibility TeamsConduct audits and regression testing
- 4. Organizations & EnterprisesMaintain consistent, scalable accessibility compliance

### Why AEM Accessibility Accelerator

Built specifically for Adobe Experience Manager 6.5+

Supports both authoring and development workflows

Visual issue highlighting with component mapping

AI-assisted remediation guidance

Reduces dependency on external Accessibility Products.
